comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Seems like it to me. I checked this out on the following JP website:

gvdb.mydns.jp/db/module/TradeDB/action/ItemShow?id=3219

When I ran the text through a translation engine, part of it said "action recovery +70 (s)". That same (s) marker showed up for Tuna Olive Steak, Burrito, and Pachamanca Dressed w/ Maca, which are also well known fleet food items. If nothing else, it's worth checking out, for the sake of curiosity.
